questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed. Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers a steep hill is coming. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you of a winding road ahead. Reduce your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down as much as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and let others go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they must drive in the direction shown when entering a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services ahead, such as rest areas, food, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a driving hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers turning left at a green light must yield to oncoming traffic and turn only when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is ahead. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: When you see a yield sign, slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand straight down, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs warn you that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is becoming narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals, so bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the beginning of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to places where animals, people, or bicycles are likely to cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long downgrade ahead. The hill may also have sharp curves.
